text: Closed with published cross-platform validation utilities in eyes4s-laws. SyntheticTrajectory.reference deterministically encodes fixation, saccade, pursuit, blink, signal loss, off-surface support, controlled spatial noise, irregular sampling jitter, an isolated dropout, and explicit affine tracker-to-stimulus clock drift. DetectorValidation returns per-present-class precision/recall/F1 and typed onset/offset MAE, signed duration bias, centre error in degrees, event-count bias, and physical peak-velocity error in deg/s; successful construction proves all relevant denominators non-empty.
